meal.title: Pick a random computer move
meal.objective: You can select a random element from the moves list

voice.script: What if the computer could surprise you every round? How does the computer pick its move? We already have a list of possible moves. To let the computer choose, we use a tool called random.choice. Random is the module that gives us unpredictable behavior, and choice selects one item from a list at random. So we write a line that says computer_choice equals random dot choice of choices. This stores a random move in the variable computer_choice. Now the computer has its own hidden pick, ready for the showdown. Remember: random.choice picks one element from a list at random. Try changing the list or printing computer_choice to see different results.
